scope: Actual finite-field elliptic curve E_b:y²=x³+b for q mod3=2, explicit char≠2,3 and b≠0. Derived cube permutation inverse x^((2q−1)/3), actual nonsingularity, actual Point≃OptionK equivalence, Nat.card E_b.Point=q+1 and actual point-count trace0. For every divisor r>2 of actual cardinality and every actual point of additive order>2, modular embedding order of q is exactly2, including composite orders. Primefield specialization for every prime p≥5/pmod3=2 derives characteristic guards, no upper p bound. Credits Galbraith Exercise9.10.4/Example9.11.4 and prior elementary minus-one order proof; no novelty or qualified source refutation. No assumed Hasse/count/point-equivalence/rank/determinant/geometric supersingularity/endomorphism/p-rank/fulltorsionfield conclusion; these general bridges remain open. Independent native written-header observation is procedural, not kernel refinement of parser/hash/execution. Standard foundations/default settings; no holes/custom axioms/native proof evaluation/global flags/raised limits/waivers/new cryptographic experiment/paid compute/agent upload.
